# biznetgio_baremetal_additional_ip (Resource)

Additional (floating) IP untuk NEO Metal. Diorder independen dari server, lalu di-attach pake `biznetgio_baremetal_additional_ip_assignment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "biznetgio_baremetal_additional_ip" "main" {
  product_id = 1
  cycle      = "m"
  region     = "wjv-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cycle` (String) Siklus billing, misal `m` (monthly) atau `a` (annual).
- `product_id` (Number) Product id dari `GET /baremetal-additional-ips/products`.

### Optional

- `pay_with_credit_card` (Boolean) Bayar invoice pake kartu kredit saat order. Default true (auto-charge). Set false kalau mau ninggalin invoice unpaid di portal — resource bakal stuck Pending sampai dibayar.
- `promocode` (String) Kode promo.
- `region` (String) Region datacenter, list valid dari `GET /baremetal-additional-ips/regions`. Default `wjv-1`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (Number) Account id additional IP di BiznetGIO.
- `created_at` (String) Tanggal dibuat (alias created_at/date_created).
- `id` (String) Resource id = account_id IP.
- `ip_address` (String) Alamat IP yang di-assign kalau ada di response.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON response terakhir dari API.
- `status` (String) Status IP (misal Active, Pending, Suspended, Terminated).

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import biznetgio_baremetal_additional_ip.main <account_id>
```
